name: Tenderly
tagline: EVM simulation, debugging, and node RPC for apps and wallets
description: Tenderly provides simulation, transaction debugging, Web3 Gateway/node RPC, Virtual TestNets, and monitoring APIs for Ethereum and other EVM chains. Developers use it to dry-run transactions, inspect traces, fork networks, and query on-chain state without running their own infrastructure. Access is typically via project-scoped API keys against api.tenderly.co and related gateway endpoints.

auth.details: Access Token (API key) via X-Access-Key header; create in Dashboard → Account Settings → Authorization. Project slug and account username required in many path-based REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes limited monthly units for simulations, Node RPC, and other products; exact unit quotas change by plan—verify on pricing page (Developer free tier available).
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and custom Enterprise plans with higher unit allowances for Node, Simulations, Alerts, and Virtual TestNets.

rate_limits: Product-specific unit/quota limits by plan; published per-product rate limits vary—check dashboard quotas and docs for Node RPC and Simulation API.
use_cases: simulate an EVM transaction before sending it
debug a failed transaction with full call traces
get Node RPC / Web3 Gateway access for an EVM chain
fork a mainnet state into a Virtual TestNet for testing
monitor contracts and set transaction alerts
